name: Generative-Pulse-Pattern
source: Pattern Studio connector, Hex pulse look (2026-11-24)
$description: Outlined hexagons in big hexagon-shaped rings that fill the frame, from the Pattern Studio connector's Hex pulse look, on the Motion Streaks gradient without the streaks: background.default → the family's 900 (5.59% → 116.67%), hexagons in the family's 800, 600 and 200, like every generative pattern. Approved in the Pattern Library review (exploration H73), 2026-11-24.

colorways.name: Background → Teal 900
colorways.onHold: Waiting for the council's approval of the sub-direction (Vanesa, 2026-11-24). Don't use it in creatives yet.

colorways.name: Neutral 100 → Neutral 300
colorways.onHold: Light mode: on hold (Vanesa, 2026-11-26). Don't use it in creatives yet.

settings.$look: Open look (Vanesa, 2026-11-25): agents may make new variations of this pattern without the Pattern Studio connector, with renderPattern(..., { look: n }) or { look: { ... } }. Only the engine values in look.ranges change, and each stays inside its range (numbers: [min, max]; words: the listed choices; cell: on the 8 grid). Colors always come from the colorway. Pulse has no approved variants yet, so only its noise changes, a little.

$colors: Elements in the family's 800, 700, 500: the lightest is never below 500 (Vanesa, 2026-11-25). Dark neutral added 2026-11-24. Light mode (on hold): every element white (Neutral 0) on Neutral 100 → 300, kept white by fixedColors.
